question: Why must this teaching be carefully concealed in the mortal world among base people?
premises: The teaching is declared something to be concealed.
Concealment must be carried out with effort.
The context of concealment is the mortal world among base people.
inference: Because the mortal world contains unworthy recipients, the teaching must be diligently kept secret.
plain_english: This teaching must be carefully concealed in the mortal world among the lowest of people.
